test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A boy can complete a piece of work alone in 10 days, but with the help of his friend he can complete it in 6 days. In how much time will his friend be able to complete the same piece of work alone ?
solution:
Given:

A boy can do work in 10 days.

A boy and his friend can do work in 6 days.

Concept Used:

Work done = Efficiency × Time 

Calculation:

A boy 1’s day’s work = 1/10

A boy and his friend 1’s day’s work = 1/6

A boy 1’s day work = 1/6 – 1/10 = (10 – 6)/6 × 10 = 4/60 = 1/15

Time taken by boy = 15 days.

**The answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ac24bef1d29c317f94f6a0cf2c3e0725b167629af806a77367a7ab72892a6db.png] 

Work done = LCM of days = 30

Efficiency of a boy = 3

Efficiency of a boy and his friend = 5

Then, Efficiency of a boy = (5 – 3) = 2

Time = 30/2 = 15 days.
